DAGGER DEEP
===========

A rogue-lite descent from the cave mouth to the dragon at the bottom of the world,
alone or with up to two friends online.


STARTING THE GAME
-----------------
Windows:  unzip the whole folder anywhere, then double-click DaggerDeep.exe.
          Windows may say it "protected your PC" (the game isn't signed):
          click "More info", then "Run anyway".
Linux:    unzip, then run ./DaggerDeep.x86_64
          (if it won't start: chmod +x DaggerDeep.x86_64).

Keep the files together: the .exe (or .x86_64), DaggerDeep.pck and the data_ folder.
It needs a graphics card with Vulkan (almost any from the last ten years).


PLAYING WITH A FRIEND
---------------------
Both of you need this same copy of the game (send your friend the zip you got).

1. On the title screen, click "Play online with friends" (or press O, or Y on a controller).

2. The HOST clicks "Host a game". A join code appears, like 7K3QD-M2XP9.
   Click Copy and send it to your friend (a chat message is fine).

3. Your FRIEND clicks Paste (or types the code) and then Join.

4. You're both in the lobby. Each of you takes a different hero
   (Swordsman, Warden or Vitalist). When everyone's ready, the host clicks
   "Start the descent". A third friend can join the same way.

In the cave:
  * Go down together: when an exit opens, everyone still standing walks into it
    (press E or up there). The first to arrive waits for the others.
  * A fallen friend can be brought back: stand beside them and hold E
    (or hold up on the stick).
    If everyone falls, the run is over.
  * Experience is shared. A chest's pick goes to whoever reaches it first.
  * Pausing doesn't stop the game online (the others keep playing).

If your friend can't connect:
  * On the same Wi-Fi / network: use the second code the host's lobby shows.
  * Over the internet, the host's router has to let your friend in. Most routers
    do this by themselves (the lobby says so). If the host's lobby says the router
    didn't, either
      - forward UDP port 24890 to the host's computer in the router's settings, or
      - both install a free "virtual LAN" such as Tailscale or ZeroTier, and have
        the friend type the host's Tailscale/ZeroTier address (like 100.101.102.103)
        in the code box instead of the code.
  * Windows may ask the host to allow the game through the firewall the first
    time: allow it (private networks is enough for the same Wi-Fi; allow public
    networks too for friends over the internet).


CONTROLS (change them in Settings: ESC / START)
-----------------------------------------------
Keyboard + mouse: A / D move, SPACE jump, LEFT CLICK attack, RIGHT CLICK ability,
F second ability, SHIFT dodge / shield / hex, E exits and reviving, Q potion.
Controller: left stick move, A jump, X attack, RB ability, RT second ability,
B dodge / shield / hex, Y potion, right stick aims.
